description: The dataset contains 104 paired samples from five medicinal plant classes.
implication: External generalization has not been established.
recommended_action: Collect independent samples and additional plant specimens.

description: Some documents produce numerically identical TF-IDF vectors.
implication: Duplicate descriptions can produce similarity ties and optimistic retrieval results.
recommended_action: Audit duplicate groups and specimen identity before constructing evaluation splits.

description: Different plant classes may share similar morphological descriptions.
implication: Text-only retrieval may confuse plants with similar textual characteristics.
recommended_action: Evaluate complementary visual information through multimodal fusion.

description: Some bigrams may originate from sentence boundaries or adjacent repeated words.
implication: Text representation may contain writing-pattern information.
recommended_action: Manually review flagged descriptions and compare a corrected corpus if appropriate.

description: Some TF-IDF features are rare, highly correlated, or numerically identical.
implication: Additional dimensions do not necessarily provide independent information.
recommended_action: Evaluate feature configurations without automatic full-gallery feature removal.

description: TF-IDF depends on vocabulary learned from reference documents.
implication: Unseen words may be ignored or produce an unusable zero vector.
recommended_action: Apply OOV detection and appropriate single-modality fallback.

description: Current vectorizers and visual normalizers were fitted using the complete gallery.
implication: Exploratory matching does not constitute independent retrieval evaluation.
recommended_action: Refit vocabulary, IDF, and visual normalization using reference data only for each evaluation split.

description: Original dataset review flags and text-specific diagnostic flags remain unresolved.
implication: Technical validity does not establish botanical or semantic correctness.
recommended_action: Complete manual quality review and document inclusion decisions.

description: Both unigram and unigram-bigram configurations remain available.
implication: The better configuration has not been established independently.
recommended_action: Select configuration and fusion weights using validation data, not final test data.
